focus: sk-git customization surface part 1: commit contract, contract-dir resolution, git-standards, allowlist, worktree naming/provisioning, Commit-Id opt-in
answeredQuestions: What is the complete inventory of sk-git customizable parts, and where is each set today?

label: SKILL.md is prose AND contract: ask-first workspace rule, never-create-branches, remote-push permission, commit grammar; mechanical pieces defer to overridable files (rules block, allowlist txt, worktree-naming.sh, provision-paths.txt, hard-rules.json)

Commit contract is data: the 'Enforced rules' JSON block in commit-message-template.md section 7 is read by validate-message.mjs and enforced identically by commit-msg hook, pre-push hook, agent gate and CI

Contract-dir order: git config skgit.contractDir (file-scope only, command-scope ignored anti-bypass) -> .sk-git/ -> shipped .skilled or .opencode assets; contractDir to missing dir throws ContractError and exit 2 blocks every commit

git-standards.cjs (the /doctor:git standards backend) already owns per-repo commit/pr/branch override: status (read-only), init (copies shipped templates into .sk-git/, dry-run default), set (never writes shipped, shape-validated, null disables a rule), disable (removes Enforced rules section), check (0/1/2)

hard-rules.json: 17 warn-severity advisory rules {id,check,message} run by the preflight advisory hook against live repo state; advise-only never blocks; SKGIT_ADVISORY=0 or SKGIT_ADVISORY_SKIP=<id|prefix> suppression; malformed edits silently weaken advisory

Remote allowlist: main + skilled/v* hardcoded and checked BEFORE the file, so remote-branch-allowlist.txt can only narrow; remote-branch creation always needs SPECKIT_ALLOW_REMOTE_PUSH=<branch> (=1 covers updates only, per-invocation); fail-open if worktree-naming.sh missing/unsourceable

Worktree naming: worktrees/NNN-slug + branches/NNN-slug independent locked counters in common git dir; base relocates via SPECKIT_WORKTREE_BASE > git config speckit.worktreeBase > .worktrees; reserved lanes skilled/v*, backup/, main, work/<runtime>/<slug>; provision installs per-repo worktree-provision-paths.txt under the no-self-link invariant
Commit-Id allocator: 7-digit ordinals minted under common-dir lock, rescanning git log --all on cold start, never reissued; prepare-commit-msg stamps Commit-Id (Spec only when applicable)

Commit-Id opt-in: git config --local skilled.commitId decides first (only local config counts so a clone cannot self-toggle); absent flag auto-detects shipped allocator or speckit sentinel or Commit-Id trailers in last 50 commits

Repo-shaped assumptions inside the shipped rules block: trailers.spec pins root specs/ + mustExist (a repo without packets must override/disable); attribution.forbiddenKeys bans Co-Authored-By/Claude-Session — the exact levers git-standards.cjs set/disable exposes
Inventory of sk-git customizable parts and where set
